confirmed_task:
On the official Daft Punk MusicBrainz artist record, use only the Album section under official release groups. Open the first three dated entries in displayed chronological order and report each title and complete First release date from its release-group page.

Stopping condition: Stop after the first three qualifying Album entries and their complete release-group First release dates have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use only the Album section under official release groups.
- Ignore undated entries and preserve the displayed chronological order of dated entries.
- Do not include Album + Compilation, Album + Live, Album + Soundtrack, Album + Remix, or any other combined section.
- Use each release-group page's First release date rather than the date of an individual release, and do not edit MusicBrainz data.

items.criterion: Use the official Daft Punk MusicBrainz artist record and correct section scope (including all constraints)
items.description: Navigate to the official Daft Punk artist page on MusicBrainz (MBID 056e4f3e-d505-4dad-8ec1-d04f521cbb56 is acceptable) and use ONLY the 'Album' section under 'official release groups'. Follow constraints: ignore undated entries, preserve the displayed chronological order of dated entries, do not use any combined sections (Album+Compilation, Album+Live, Album+Soundtrack, Album+Remix, etc.), and use each release-group page's 'First release date' field (do not substitute individual release dates or edit data). Full credit if the agent follows this scope and constraints OR if MusicBrainz is inaccessible/blocked (captcha, downtime, rate limit) and the agent clearly reports the access issue and what it attempted. Partial credit if the correct artist is used but there is minor scope leakage (e.g., one item from a combined section) when MusicBrainz is accessible.

items.criterion: Album entry #1: first dated entry in displayed chronological order
items.description: Identify the first qualifying dated Album entry in the displayed chronological order within the 'Album' section (ignoring undated entries). Open that release-group page and report (a) the release-group title and (b) the complete 'First release date' as shown on the release-group page. Full credit if both title and complete first release date are correctly taken from the release-group page. If the release-group page cannot be accessed due to external issues (blocking/downtime) after a reasonable attempt, award full credit if the agent explicitly states it could not retrieve the release-group 'First release date' and does not invent it. Partial credit if the title is correct but the date is incomplete or clearly taken from an individual release while the release-group page was accessible.

items.criterion: Album entry #2: second dated entry in displayed chronological order
items.description: Identify the second qualifying dated Album entry in the displayed chronological order (ignoring undated entries). Open its release-group page and report the release-group title and complete 'First release date' from that page. Full credit if both fields are correct and sourced from the release-group page. If the release-group page cannot be accessed due to external issues after a reasonable attempt, award full credit if the agent clearly reports the inability to retrieve the 'First release date' and does not fabricate it. Partial credit if only one field is correct, or if the date is mis-sourced from an individual release when the release-group page was accessible.

items.criterion: Album entry #3: third dated entry in displayed chronological order (and stop after three)
items.description: Identify the third qualifying dated Album entry in the displayed chronological order (ignoring undated entries), open its release-group page, and report its title and complete release-group 'First release date'. Stop after recording three qualifying entries. Full credit if both fields are correct and sourced from the release-group page and the agent stops after three entries. If the release-group page cannot be accessed due to external issues after a reasonable attempt, award full credit if the agent reports the inability to retrieve the 'First release date' and does not invent it, and still stops after three. Partial credit if the correct entry is identified but the date is incomplete/mis-sourced while the page was accessible, or if the agent continues beyond three entries.
